mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to construct a world where a HospitalAdministrator AccessAttempt has outcome=Permitted on RecordLookup or AddNote. LeastPrivilege requires all Permitted outcomes to respect the matrix (which excludes HospitalAdministrator from clinical ops), and FR_005_AdminNoClinicAccess directly asserts this cannot happen.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminCannotAccessClinicalContent { some aa: AccessAttempt | aa.aaCaller.userRole = HospitalAdministrator and aa.aaOperation = RecordLookup and aa.aaOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy construct an AccessAttempt with outcome=Permitted on a clinical endpoint without any CareTeamMembership linking the caller to the patient. OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_004_CareTeamGating both assert this is impossible; the injection forces exactly that structure.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGating { some aa: AccessAttempt | aa.aaOperation = RecordLookup and aa.aaOutcome = Permitted and no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = aa.aaCaller and m.ctmPatient = aa.aaPatient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a single AuditEntry to be shared by two distinct AccessAttempts, simulating a mutated or overwritten audit row. FR_014_AuditImmutability requires every AuditEntry to have exactly one parent attempt; the injection makes two attempts share one entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditEntryBelongsToOneAttempt { some disj aa1, aa2: AccessAttempt | aa1.aaAuditEntry = aa2.aaAuditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a ClinicalNote to appear as the aaCreatedNote of two distinct AccessAttempts, simulating an update/edit of an existing note. AppendOnly and FR_011_NotesAppendOnly assert each note is produced by at most one attempt.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteCreatedByOneAttempt { some disj aa1, aa2: AccessAttempt | some n: ClinicalNote | aa1.aaCreatedNote = n and aa2.aaCreatedNote = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AuditEntry to carry a role snapshot that does not match the accessor's actual role, simulating misattribution. AttributionCorrectness asserts the snapshot must equal the accessor's userRole.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditRoleSnapshotMatchesCaller { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeRoleSnapshot != ae.aeAccessor.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a clinical-role AccessAttempt to obtain Permitted on ListAudit, violating the administrator-only gate. FR_017_AdminOnlyAuditEndpoint asserts clinical roles never receive Permitted on this endpoint; the injection forces exactly that.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminOnlyListAudit { some aa: AccessAttempt | aa.aaCaller.userRole = Doctor and aa.aaOperation = ListAudit and aa.aaOutcome = Permitted }
